## Medical Molding with Xometry


## Medical Molding with Xometry


### Summary


Navigate the complexities of medical device manufacturing with Xometry's comprehensive injection molding solutions. Join Kyra Stawson, senior solutions engineer for injection molding, and Jesse Becker, strategic account executive for the medical vertical, for their expertise and insights on accelerating time-to-market, optimizing costs, and maintaining stringent quality standards with medical injection molding.


This webinar will provide a walkthrough of how Xometry manages your medical manufacturing needs with topics including:


✔ What sets Xometry apart in medical molding, from molding processes, tool types, tight tolerances, finishes, materials, countries of origin, DFM support, and more.


✔ Quick-turn prototype offerings compared to production capabilities and procedures


✔ Case studies examples and lessons learned from prototype to production


✔ Tools and resources available at Xometry


### Questions and Answers from the Webinar


Do Xometry's partners have post-processing capabilities?


Yes, we have a diversity of suppliers and secondary finishing within our network. Xometry's AI-driven marketplace makes us an ideal supply chain for medical part manufacturing. Learn more about ourmedical injection molding services .


Can you do overmolding for a Quick Turn option?


Yes, overmolding and insert molding are available with competitive lead times. Tools can be produced in parallel to avoid bottlenecks in production.


Can customers do site visits to your suppliers?


Our team regularly hosts on-site visits and audits for injection mold production projects. You would work with your account representative to set this up.


How does interacting with DFM engineers fit into the auto-quote and order process I see on your website (when I add my design and prepare to place an order)? Can we get feedback before the order is actually placed?


There are multiple ways to produce a mold for a given design, and it all depends on the context. Our platform allows you to securely share your project and submit it for a manual review. We can quickly return budgetary pricing and ask follow-up questions to determine the best-value strategy for your project.


Your project's stage gates will be displayed on your[Tool Library and Tool Details](https://www.xometry.com/how-xometry-works/tool-details/) page, allowing you to understand where you are in the process.


Who does the inspections \[mentioned in the webinar\]?


Both our suppliers and Xometry can perform inspections. This will be contextual depending on the project requirements.
